We must verify backup usability, recovery dependencies, and a restoration estimate before committing to any service-restoration time. Unknown technical factors remain unverified.

We must support staff and service users immediately. Operating the approved paper appointment process is our feasible fallback for essential appointments. Service manager Morgan Ellis can run it once the board authorizes activation. IT dependencies, backup usability, and restoration estimates remain unknown. Staff availability is also currently unknown. We should protect ongoing care without making unverified promises.

The board must formally authorize both appointing an interim incident coordinator and activating paper appointments. External IT support cannot authorize spending. We must check existing financial delegations, emergency spending authority, and any contracts covering supplier costs. Available funds and cost limits remain unconfirmed. Each member must consider these governance requirements when framing individual proposals.
